LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.4 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Pronunciation • Fluency (pauses) By the 
Topic 2.6: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading 2.4 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Pronunciation • Fluency (pauses) By the  in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What strategies can you use to read aloud effectively?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: The learner displays effective communication skills as they use vocabulary on the theme to construct simple

sentences on their preferences for food items.

Values:
Unity: The learner respects other people’s opinions as they discuss what determines their preferences or dislikes for various

foods items.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health education: The learner develops an appreciation for different foods and deepens their understanding of food culture and

the various factors that affect it.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner relates the concept of tastes of various food items to Agriculture and Nutrition.
